Construction notice:
Rumpel Felt partial demolition
City of Kitchener
November 2026 - March 2027

60 Victoria St. N., Kitchener

Notice date: November 9, 2026

About the project
The Region of Waterloo has contracted ROMEO Demolition & Excavation Inc. for the
partial demolition of the Rumpel Felt building. This will include the demolition of the non-
heritage designated parts of the building. The original 1913 portion of the building will be
retained. The demolition is being completed to prepare the site for the construction of
the Kitchener Central Transit Hub.

Timing — starts on or about November 12, 2026
Work will begin on or about November 12, 2026, and extend through late March 2027.

Construction impacts (or lane reductions)
Throughout demolition, two-way traffic and driveway access will be maintained. There
may be periods of temporary lane closures to facilitate work.

Pedestrian access
Temporary sidewalk closures in front of Rumpel Felt along Victoria Street North and
Duke Street are expected. Pedestrians should follow the signs as they walk through the
area.

Property and business access
All businesses in the area will remain open and accessible. Please plan for some travel
delays near the work area. When driving or walking within the area, follow and obey
signage for your safety and for the safety of the workers.

Dust, mud and vibration
You may notice slight vibrations from the contractor’s equipment during the demolition
work. All efforts will be made to minimize adverse impacts including dust, mud, and
vibration.
